# Class: `TemperatureTags`

Draws and drags the active sample's temperature tags below the plot.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-plot.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_plot.py#L67) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QWidget`.

Reserves a fixed-height lane, maps tags to the current plot coordinates, and honors locked boundaries. Movement signals identify the sample, boundary, temperature, and whether the drag has finished; the panel applies the edit.
